Name: Weapon Stats
Author: HamBandit
Description:
[center]Weapon Stats is a mod that allows you to adjust a wide variety of stats for weapons.

Weapons can have their Area of Effect, Crit Chance, Crit Multiplier, Defense, Knockback, Min/Max Damage, and Speed adjusted to whatever values you like!
You can also specify if it is possible for that weapon to be lost on death!

Use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make editing the weapon stats even easier.

Existing weapons are not affected by changes, only weapons acquired after the changes are made will be affected.
[b]
BY DEFAULT, THIS MOD DOES NOT MAKE ANY CHANGES TO ANY WEAPON STATS![/b]
[b]
------

PLEASE NOTE!!!
[/b][b]This mods Default is set to Vanilla values, this means it may override other mods that change weapon values.[/b]
[size=1][i]For example: Stardew Valley Expanded makes some changes to weapons that will no longer apply when using this mod, though those stats can be applied using this mod. [/i]
